title.suggested: Jem Mace said to accept Tom Allen's challenge

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Evening Dispatch noted in its local briefs that Jem Mace was said to have accepted Tom Allen's challenge to fight.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'The Dispatch, Tuesday Evening, February 24, 1874'; Post-Dispatch did not exist until 1878

facts.fact: Jem Mace was reported to have accepted Allen's challenge to fight
